title: Weapon template
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Defines a weapon that can be mounted on a ship. Physical quantities follow ADR-0008 (value+unit objects). Allowed units are defined in the central units registry (assets/json/schema/units.schema.json).

projectile_template.description: Name of the projectile template to use (e.g., 'laser-standard').

fire_rate.description: Fire rate in rounds per second.

sound.description: Sound file path relative to assets/audio/ (e.g., "fire.wav"). Optional; if not provided, no sound is played on fire.
